name: ember_rose
source: ember_rose, authored as 7 control points (black through maroon, crimson and a red-orange to an orange and a warm gold) as the albedo of the ember_rose style, from 406031.jpg: a black ground, red-orange threads and petals, copper lace, gold beads.
